meta.rationale: Iteration 1 — the milestone-1 keyword-search baseline is validated. A new report-side probe (report.json `keyword`) scores the non-learned inverted-index kw predictor directly on data/cldr.jsonl: exact-postings Acc@1 = 0.966, which clears the priority-1 gate (>= 0.95 exact). The remaining open gate is short-text emoji Acc@1 (emoji.eval, best fusion variant = Fusion.Gain, 0.538). Two sub-signals stay in view: model-only CLDR Acc@1 (0.312 — the encoder has not learned bare keyword->emoji, expected for milestone 1) and fusion Acc@1 on CLDR (0.680 — the shipped default combiner drags the clean kw ranking down with model noise; combiner routing is recommend-only work).
